cpt.title: 累积前景理论：价值函数、概率权重与四重风险态度
Cumulative Prospect Theory: value function, probability weighting and the fourfold pattern
cpt.desc: v(x) 相对参照点定义，收益域凹、损失域凸、损失侧更陡 (λ>1)；w(p) 高估小概率、低估中高概率。二者叠加产生四重风险态度，也是彩票与保险同时存在的解释。

v(x) is defined relative to a reference point: concave for gains, convex for losses, steeper on the loss side (λ>1); w(p) overweights small and underweights moderate-to-high probabilities. Together they produce the fourfold pattern of risk attitudes, explaining why lotteries and insurance coexist.

cpt.note.label: 局限：
Limitations:
cpt.note.text: 参照点 r 不可直接观察，也非外生；不同参照点会导出完全不同的预测。把「不愿止损」一律归为损失厌恶，会忽略税收、交易成本、私有信息与学习等理性解释。

The reference point r is neither directly observable nor exogenous; different reference points yield very different predictions. Attributing every reluctance to cut losses to loss aversion ignores rational explanations such as taxes, trading costs, private information and learning.
mla.title: 短视损失厌恶与股权溢价之谜
Myopic loss aversion and the equity premium puzzle
mla.desc: Benartzi-Thaler：损失厌恶 λ 与「评估频率」结合，就能内生出很高的股票要求回报。评估越频繁，看到亏损的概率越大，心理成本越高——这为股权溢价之谜提供了一种行为解释。

Benartzi-Thaler: combining loss aversion λ with evaluation frequency endogenously produces a high required return on equities. The more often you evaluate, the more likely you see a loss and the higher the psychological cost — a behavioral explanation of the equity premium puzzle.

mla.note.label: 争议：
Debate:
mla.note.text: 评估频率并不可观测，且长期投资者未必按日结算；实证上机构与散户的评估周期差异是否真的映射到定价，仍有分歧。

Evaluation frequency is unobservable and long-horizon investors need not settle daily; whether differences in evaluation periods between institutions and retail investors actually map into prices remains disputed.
bsv.title: BSV：保守主义 + 代表性 → 反应不足接过度反应
BSV: conservatism + representativeness → underreaction then overreaction
bsv.desc: 投资者以为盈利在「均值回复」与「趋势」两个制度间切换。保守主义使公告当期反应不足，随后缓慢漂移；代表性使连续好消息被外推，价格冲过基本面，长期再反转。

Investors believe earnings switch between a mean-reverting and a trending regime. Conservatism causes underreaction at announcement followed by slow drift; representativeness extrapolates streaks of good news, pushing prices past fundamentals before a long-run reversal.

bsv.note.label: 检验要点：
Testing:
bsv.note.text: BSV 的可证伪含义在截面——在信息更模糊、分析师覆盖更少的股票上，漂移与反转都应更强。这才是与「风险溢价解释」的分水岭。

BSV's falsifiable implication is cross-sectional — drift and reversal should be stronger for stocks with vaguer information and less analyst coverage. That is what separates it from risk-premium explanations.
dhs.title: DHS：过度自信与自我归因偏差
DHS: overconfidence and self-attribution bias
dhs.desc: 投资者高估私有信号精度 (k>1) 造成即时过度反应；自我归因使确认性公开信息进一步强化信念（延续的动量），而最终公开信息把价格拉回基本面——长期反转。

Investors overestimate private-signal precision (k>1), causing immediate overreaction; self-attribution lets confirming public news further strengthen beliefs (continued momentum), until public information eventually pulls prices back to fundamentals — long-run reversal.

hs.title: 信息缓慢扩散 + 动量交易者的统一解释
Slow information diffusion + momentum traders: a unified explanation
hs.desc: 新闻在 z 期内逐步扩散到「新闻观察者」，造成天然的反应不足；动量交易者观察到过去 j 期的价格趋势并追随，把反应不足放大为过冲，最终反转。无需任何个体层面的认知偏差。

News diffuses gradually to news-watchers over z periods, creating natural underreaction; momentum traders follow the past j-period trend, amplifying underreaction into overshoot and eventual reversal. No individual-level cognitive bias is required.
